content.title: It’s a Big Day for Cisco Stock. It Has Highest Close Since Dot-Com Bubble Burst.
content.summary: Cisco Systems  stock was once one of the most notable victims of the dot-com bubble bursting in 2000.  Cisco stock rose 0.9% on Wednesday to $80.25, closing at a record high for the first time since March 27, 2000.  This new record comes as shares have jumped 36% this year and are on pace for their best year to date performance through Dec. 10 since 2009, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
